# 2 Clement — Chapter 19 (EMET Literal)

**Source:** Codex Alexandrinus, 2 Clement 19
**Agent:** EMET (Literal)
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

1. So then, brothers and sisters, after the God of truth I am reading to you an exhortation to pay attention to what is written, so that you may save both yourselves and the one who reads among you.
2. For as a fee I ask you to repent with your whole heart, giving salvation and life to yourselves. By doing this, we shall set a goal for all the young people who wish to toil in the study of piety and love.
3. And let us not — who are foolish — be displeased and vexed whenever someone admonishes us and turns us from unrighteousness to righteousness.
4. For sometimes when we do evil things, we do not perceive it because of the double-mindedness and unbelief that is in our breasts, and we are darkened in our understanding by our empty desires.
5. Let us therefore practice righteousness so that we may be saved in the end. Blessed are they who obey these ordinances; even if they endure hardships for a little time in the world, they will gather the immortal fruit of the resurrection.
6. Let not the pious man be grieved if he is wretched in the present times; a blessed time awaits him.
7. When he comes to life again with those who have revived above, he will rejoice for ever and ever in the world that does not die, having suffered nothing painful.
